sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Doctrine: .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md. Rust. u1 lives in crates/cli/src/main.rs (clap verbs: send/inbox/state/report… — find every `seat: Option<String>` / --from arg) + a new small module crates/cli/src/identity.rs: `resolve_acting_seat(env, pane, client) -> Result<SeatId, NamedRefusal>`. Send every available identity input to POST /v1/whoami: the daemon's one authority treats an observable pane as authoritative, accepts PIJ_SESSION_ID only when no pane contradicts it, and refuses disagreement by name. Do NOT re-implement the daemon's ladder: the shim already uses crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs resolve_seat. Body sources: --body, --body-file <path>, --body-file - (stdin), read literally and never through shell evaluation (clap `allow_hyphen_values` on --body). msg-id minting: uuid crate v7 (or ulid) — check Cargo.lock for what is already present, add nothing new if avoidable. u2: crates/daemon/src/pointer/mod.rs render_pointer text (`run: pij inbox` → `run: pij inbox check`) + adopt response text in crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs. Ruling: weasel 2026-09-02 — every pane-bound harness, including omp/pi, gets pane-derived identity guidance; export advice is paneless-only.

value.rationale: One crate, one module, two text edits. PM codes, proves live, Claude opus reviewer.

Default: each coder gets its own worktree, branching off the PM's plan branch; unit lands back onto the plan branch (PM merges — coders never merge). Shared-tree work is the retro-proven #1 hazard (staged sweeps, untrustworthy greens) — only choose it for trivially disjoint single-wave work, and then file-scoped `git add` only, never -A. REMEMBER: fences partition WRITE intent, not the build — a mid-refactor sibling can still break your compile, so waves must respect build dependencies, and a broken workspace build is a PM composition concern, not a coder's to fix cross-fence.

value.steps: Rebase onto origin/main after plan 128 merges (ask prime); build; cargo test; clippy; harness checks (symlink canonical node_modules); live AC1/AC2/AC4 against an ISOLATED daemon (never restart production) with hand-started omp + claude panes pointed at it via PIJ_RS_ADDR/PIJ_RS_STATE_DIR.

value.text: A --from that agrees with the pane is fine; the refusal must fire only on DISAGREEMENT (test both).
